verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents creating campaigns from external AI chat tools (docs-42) and a Marketing API with a separate 'send campaign' action (docs-5, docs-1). That implies an agent could create a campaign and stop short of sending it. However, nothing in the pack shows targeting a segment, scheduling, or an explicit draft or approval queue for human sign-off. missing for 10: documented segment targeting on agent-created campaigns, schedule endpoint or scheduled-state docs, explicit human-approval/review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
